 The Golden State Warriors travel to Ball Arena to face the Denver Nuggets on Monday night, looking to secure their first victory of the 2026-27 NBA season.
 Mar 29, 2026; Denver, Colorado, USA; Denver Nuggets center Nikola Jokic (15) controls the ball as Golden State Warriors forward Draymond Green (23) guards in the third quarter at Ball Arena. Mandatory Credit: Isaiah J. Downing-Imagn Images
 How to Watch Warriors vs Nuggets
 When: Monday, October 26, 2026
 Time: 10:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBC Sports Network
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Golden State has stumbled out of the gate with a 0-3 record, most recently falling to the Phoenix Suns 131-122 on Saturday. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg was a bright spot in the loss, finishing with 26 points, nine rebounds, and five assists, while De’Anthony Melton added 25 points. The Warriors will welcome Stephen Curry and Draymond Green back to the lineup after both sat out Saturday’s contest, providing a much-needed boost against one of the Western Conference’s most talented teams.
 Denver enters the matchup at 1-1 after an impressive 141-135 overtime victory over the New Orleans Pelicans. Jamal Murray erupted for 42 points, while Nikola Jokic recorded a triple-double with 35 points, 15 rebounds, and 10 assists to help the Nuggets overcome a 23-point deficit. With Curry and Jokic leading their respective teams, Monday night’s showdown features two of the NBA’s biggest stars as Golden State looks to avoid an 0-4 start.
